svg.title: About Eren Erdoğan
svg.desc: I study backend development and work on cybersecurity, Linux systems, and secure software engineering. My tools focus on verifiable, local-first analysis across binaries, emails, timelines, and traffic. Through practical projects and security labs, I work on malware triage, digital forensics, OSINT, penetration testing, and backend architecture.
